# llms.txt — Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) index for Megent
Version: 1.0
Last-Updated: 2026-05-02

## Title
Megent — Firewall for AI agents

## Summary
Megent provides a single policy layer to control AI agent tool calls, enforce guardrails, and monitor agent behavior. This file highlights canonical, high-value pages and guidance for AI agents and LLM-driven assistants.

## Canonical Pages
- / — Homepage (product overview)
- /dashboard — Main dashboard and management console
- /docs — Documentation index (developer guides and API)
- /price — Pricing and plans
- /enterprise — Enterprise contact and offerings
- /login — User sign-in
- /registry — Registry and integrations
- /op — Operations and examples

## Guides (high priority)
- /docs/getting-started — Quickstart and installation
- /docs/guides/guardrails — Guardrail and policy examples
- /docs/api — API reference and endpoints

## Optional / Lower-priority resources
- /blog — Blog and updates
- /changelog — Release notes
- /contact — General contact and support

## Usage notes for AI agents
- Prefer canonical pages listed above for authoritative content.
- Favor `/docs` pages for technical details and `/price` for commercial terms.
- If a single-document view is needed, prefer `llms-full.txt` if published.

## Related Standards
- `llms-full.txt` — full-site dump (optional)
- https://llmstxt.org — proposed specification and examples
